{{Top|leg}}
'''Speeder A23''' was the designation of a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] assigned to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhamalai]]. During an escape attempt using falsified orders to depart the garrison, [[Denel Moonrunner]], [[Nadra Enasteri]] and [[Charis Enasteri]] were directed to use Speeder A23. However, they took a speeder closer to them due to Charis' medical condition.<ref name="Rhamalai">{{JournalCite|13|The Occupation of Rhamalai}}</ref>
